title: Quiz: Web Components
description: Check your understanding of Web Components.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: What does Shadow DOM provide?
options: Style and DOM encapsulation for a component
questions.correctAnswer: Style and DOM encapsulation for a component
questions.explanation: Shadow trees keep component internals separate from the page.

questions.question: True or False: Custom element names must contain a hyphen.
Fill in the blank: customElements.${m}("my-element", MyClass)
questions.explanation: define() registers the element with the browser.

questions.question: In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
